note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown, and both the soldier and the worker are described; the end of the account slice also contains the full text of the following species, N. dunensis, which was not used; synonymy citations, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown with a smoky tinge, fontanelle region paler; nasus brown, darker distally; antennae brown; pronotum slightly paler than head; legs and abdominal tergites light brown. Vertex with a pair of long hairs, a pair behind nasus, and several minute hairs; nasus with a tuft of short hairs at tip; pronotum densely covered with minute hairs; each abdominal tergite with one long hair on each side and a pair at middle, plus several short hairs; sternites with long and short hairs. Body length 4.40–5.10 mm. Head capsule subcircular, distinctly wider than long excluding nasus (2.00–2.20 mm long including nasus, 1.25–1.35 mm long excluding nasus, 1.35–1.47 mm maximum width); sides distinctly narrowed anteriorly; in lateral view nearly straight, without nasus swelling. Nasus short, conical, thick at base; slightly more than half head length (0.70–0.85 mm long, nasus length/head length index 0.54–0.63). Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 nearly twice as long as segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, each with a distinct spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.30–0.34 mm long, 0.60–0.68 mm wide); anterior margin rounded, unnotched; posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule smoky brown at occiput, light brown elsewhere; antennae and labrum tinged with brown; pronotum dark straw yellow; abdomen paler than pronotum. Head sparsely hairy; pronotum with a few hairs; each abdominal tergite with one long hair on lateral margin and a pair at middle, plus several minute hairs; sternites more densely hairy. Body length 5.0–5.9 mm. Head subquadrate; slightly less long than wide (1.05–1.20 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.17–1.37 mm wide); coronal suture indistinct. Fontanelle plate translucent, slightly long. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.30–0.40 mm long, 0.78–0.85 mm wide); anterior margin very weakly notched, posterior margin straight.
